verdict.rationale: An agent-skills package with workflow and task-execution features could plausibly offer recurring schedules, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only one-off execution: the Ralph loop runs "exactly one explicitly assigned" task, and the ledger offers dependency ordering and readiness checks. Nothing documents a cron-like or recurring schedule for jobs or workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
